turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi! How's life treating you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Kind of tired, honestly.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My cat keeps scratching the couch. It's shredded on one side.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Poor couch. Does she have a scratching post?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A little one, she ignores it.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Then try either a tall sturdy post right by the couch, or a flat cardboard scratcher. Which do you think she'd like?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Can you hang on? I have to talk to someone here. I'll tell you when I'm back.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Okay, no rush.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Emma, can you help me figure out the food?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Sure. Are we doing a meal or just snacks?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Snacks, I think. People will come and go all evening.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Then a big cheese board, some dips, and maybe mini sandwiches.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: And something for the vegans. Is hummus enough?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Add roasted veggies and some fruit. That's plenty.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Sorry, what were you saying?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Just that the bus was late again.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, I'm back.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: No problem. You were picking between a tall scratching post and a flat scratcher for your cat.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Probably the flat one, she loves scratching the rug too.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Then a cardboard scratcher on the floor next to the couch is a great bet. They're cheap, so try a couple.
